# Decision resistance

## Data migration and conditions of implementation

|  |
| --- |
| The quality of historical data, the degree of standardization of processes, interface privileges and the complexity of existing systems affect the go-live cycle. Template implementation, departmental testing and formal access across the system usually correspond to different implementation ranges. |

## Organizational use and data quality

|  |
| --- |
| The value of the CRM, procurement and visualization configuration platforms depends on continuous recording. If there is an increase in the number of steps, the data will soon be distorted and the management panel will fail. |

## AI Accuracy and responsibility

|  |
| --- |
| AI minutes, client recommendations, contract reviews, value for money, inventory projections could all go wrong. The closer to financial, contractual and operational decisions, the higher the wrong cost. |

## Overall cost of ownership

|  |
| --- |
| The overall cost of ownership usually consists of the components of seating, implementation, model usage, storage, interfaces, privatized hardware, upgrades and ongoing services, depending on the manner of deployment and the scope of the project. |
